from qiskit.circuit.library import HGate, CZGate

n_qubits = 5
qc = QuantumCircuit(n_qubits)

# Apply Hadamard gates to all qubits
for qubit in range(n_qubits):
    qc.append(HGate(), [qubit])

# Apply CZ gates between consecutive qubits
for qubit in range(n_qubits - 1):
    qc.append(CZGate(), [qubit, qubit + 1])

# Apply inverse Hadamard gates to all qubits
for qubit in range(n_qubits):
    qc.append(HGate().inverse(), [qubit])

# Measure all qubits
for qubit in range(n_qubits):
    qc.measure(qubit, qubit)

# Print the circuit
print(qc)

from qiskit.circuit.library import PauliEvolutionGate, CUGate

# Define the evolution time (gamma)

# Transpile the circuit for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map

from qiskit.transpiler.passes import BasisTranslator, UnitarySynthesis

# Define the basis gates for the LINEAR coupling map

# Create a pass manager with the necessary passes
pm = PassManager([
    BasisTranslator(basis_gates),
    UnitarySynthesis(basis_gates)
])

# Transpile the circuit
qc = pm.run(qc)

# Print the transpiled circuit
print(qc.draw())

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import HGate, RZGate, CXGate

qc = QuantumCircuit(5)

# Apply Hadamard gates to all qubits
for qubit in range(5):
    qc.append(HGate(), [qubit])

# Apply RZ gates to all qubits
for qubit in range(5):
    qc.append(RZGate(0.1), [qubit])

# Apply CNOT gates in a linear entanglement pattern
for qubit in range(4):
    qc.append(CXGate(), [qubit, qubit + 1])

# Apply RZ gates to all qubits again
for qubit in range(5):
    qc.append(RZGate(0.2), [qubit])

# Apply CNOT gates in a reverse linear entanglement pattern
for qubit in range(4, 0, -1):
    qc.append(CXGate(), [qubit, qubit - 1])

# Apply RZ gates to all qubits one last time
for qubit in range(5):
    qc.append(RZGate(0.3), [qubit])

# Decompose the circuit to get a more detailed unitary matrix
qc_decomposed = qc.decompose()

# Print the unitary matrix
print(qc_decomposed.to_gate().to_matrix())
